summary: "Fenced claims stay safe throughout; what runs twice is the unfenced passes" was FALSE for the different-database SplitBrain cause: epoch_fence_sql is a subselect on leader_state in the claim's own database, the epoch comes from a per-database sequence, the advisory lock is per database, so replicas on different databases each pass their own fence and both run every leader-only pass (a forked database can send one occurrence twice, absorbed only by the agent command_id dedup). First raised as dw-S1 by docs-writer (Gate 2); architect derived HIGH. Fixed across yuzu-alerts.yml, server-admin.md, metrics.md, ADR-2002, changelog (d9d72097c).

Rolling upgrade from a binary without the series can false-fire NoLeader (old leader exports nothing; upgraded follower 0 sums to 0). Note added to upgrading.md (reload rules after the last replica or silence).

Matrix WS-11 row lacked the "SplitBrain verified by promtool only" caveat the skill row carries. Added.

trigger: primary freezes with kernel ACKs; scrape_timeout elapses
summary: In a whole-primary stall (kernel keeps ACKing) the /metrics handler's own pool queries (outbox count_pending before the leader publish; mgmt-group counts after) hang, the scrape fails, every leader series goes stale and every leader rule evaluates empty, so CoordinationStale is blind exactly there. chaos-injector: reordering the leader publish does not help (response written last). DOCUMENTED in this change (group header, Stale comment, runbook, metrics.md, observability-conventions.md: every rule needs a successful scrape; configure an up==0 alert on your own job). Code fix (decoupled refresher) deferred: proposed issue "/metrics must not block on pool queries".
classification_rationale: blind spot documented honestly; code half deferred

trigger: network blip >= 15 s on the supported single-server deployment
summary: Single-replica self-lockout: after a >=15 s blip the replica reconnects but its OWN old backend keeps the session advisory lock until Postgres notices (keepalives ~2 h by default); try-lock returns false (not counted); NoLeader pages after 5 m; the five leader-only passes stay paused while /readyz is green. Pre-existing behaviour of the elector; this change makes it visible. DOCUMENTED (runbook: client_addr/backend_start, own-zombie explanation). Code fix deferred: proposed issue "single-replica leadership lockout after a network blip".

trigger: lagging asynchronous Patroni promotion plus a paused (not dead) ex-leader
summary: Residual after arch-F1: the epoch fence is not monotonic across a LOSSY ASYNCHRONOUS promotion (nextval + leader_state upsert are ordinary WAL; a promoted standby missing the last commits can re-mint an epoch a paused ex-leader still holds). architect adjudication (Gate 8): likely, PRE-EXISTING in unchanged code, not specific to the epoch; the shipped HA profile defaults to synchronous quorum3 (so a promoted standby has every committed mint); exposure only under YUZU_PG_DURABILITY=async or a degraded non-strict quorum; bounded today because a second replica is unsupported. This change's docs no longer claim safety across an async promotion (yml header + server-admin SplitBrain bullet qualified, 7a336a7bc). Code/DDL fix (monotonic re-mint or a synchronous_standby_names check) deferred: proposed issue "HA: epoch fence is not monotonic across a lossy (async) Postgres promotion". NEEDS HUMAN SIGN-OFF: a derived-HIGH finding in code this diff does not touch is waived to a follow-up that must gate lifting the safe-to-scale gate.
classification_rationale: pre-existing design limit; branch docs now honest
adjudicated_by: architect (Gate 8 UP-3 adjudication 2026-10-26; not the change author; independence asserted, same-session actor)
adjudication_rationale: pre-existing in unchanged leader_elector.cpp; default HA profile is synchronous quorum; exposure only under async/degraded durability; no second replica supported; the diff's own claims were qualified so it advertises no control that is not enforced
waiver_rationale: gating finding allowed to pass for THIS diff only: the defect is outside the diff, the branch adds no claim covering it, and a follow-up must gate lifting the safe-to-scale gate

summary: No up{job}==0 backstop alert for the server ships; every leader rule needs a successful scrape. DOCUMENTED with actionable advice (use your own job name, a for: of a few scrape intervals, probe /readyz, scrape_timeout note); the alert itself deferred as a new surface.

Runbook "restart the replica" can hang at resign(): the election loop holds mu_ across a wedged PQexec, so SIGTERM waits for the supervisor stop timeout or a second signal. Pre-existing; documented in the Stale branch. Proposed issue "resign() hang on a wedged PQexec".

A dead standby (elector cannot open / loop throws while another replica leads) raises acquire_failures{connect} or loop_errors_total but no rule consumes them. Multi-replica only; second replica unsupported. Proposed issue "standby elector health is invisible".

Two Yuzu deployments under one Prometheus job (the shipped configs all use yuzu-server) false-page SplitBrain and mask NoLeader. Requirement documented (group header, runbook, upgrading.md); a per-deployment label deferred. Proposed issue.

Planned Postgres maintenance >5 m fires NoLeader critical with no silence guidance. Added: silence scoped to the job, ending at the window plus ~10 minutes, confirm is_leader 1 afterwards (server-admin.md, upgrading.md).

spdlog::error inside the election-loop catch could terminate the thread. cpp-safety (not the raiser, not the author) refuted at Gate 8: spdlog here is compiled with exceptions, logger::log_ wraps format+sink in SPDLOG_TRY/CATCH and routes std::exception to err_handler_ (no custom handler on the default logger), e.what() is noexcept, and leader_loop_errors_.fetch_add precedes the log call in both arms. Residual: a non-std exception from a sink, or a second bad_alloc inside err_handler_, are double faults the loop guard already accepts.
refuted_by: grep of meson.build and spdlog tweakme.h (no SPDLOG_NO_EXCEPTIONS); spdlog logger::log_ SPDLOG_TRY/SPDLOG_LOGGER_CATCH; set_error_handler only in log_handoff.cpp and guardian_ingest.cpp; fetch_add sequenced before spdlog::error
refuted_by_reporter: cpp-safety (Gate 8 iteration 2; not the change author, not the raiser)
